data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil). Prior year claims development is analysis by line of business in the table below.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2014) was GBP 18.715m. The technical provisions note shows a gross prior year movement of a release of GBP 6.898m (gross), equivalent to a ~36.9% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding; the net effect after reinsurer's share is a favourable prior year development of GBP 4.797m (reported net as GBP 4.8m). The movement is described as favourable prior year development and is not attributed to any specific named catastrophe in the report.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement taken from Technical Provisions note (note 17) where 'Change in prior year provisions' gross = (6,898) GBP 000 => -6.898m (release). The report also states a net favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m; the exact_reserve_text quoted is the net wording. Line-of-business prior-year breakdown in the claims note is presented net of reinsurance; lob_movements entries are mapped and amounts reflect the net figures reported in that table (hence lower confidence). The claims development table present in the notes is limited to 2014/2015 columns only; no older-year triangle was available to compute PYD via a triangle method.
